title: Review on Critique AI
body: I like the app and the way it makes you improve, especially the leaderboards that make it more inspiring and motivating to use. The only reasons that it isn’t a 5 is the fact that it’s not free/cheaper and for the fact that you pay £40 a year yet you still get ads is quite annoying. I would recommend it to people who are serious but I think the idea and most of the execution is great.
